anatomy.disc: a gradient in the person's tone, radius 999
anatomy.initials: white, semibold, one or two letters

copy.initials: The first letters of the first two words of the name.

keyboard.None: An avatar is not interactive and not in the Tab order.

components.name: Avatar

rules.text: An avatar is square, so it draws a circle.
The same name always gets the same tone.
An avatar is named by the person's full name for assistive technology, not by its initials.

components.summary: Shows a person as a coloured disc with their initials.

a11y.name: Its text, read with the thing beside it.

copy.text: A count or one word: 3, Online, Beta.

keyboard.None: A badge is not interactive and not in the Tab order.

components.name: Badge

rules.text: A badge is one word or a count, twelve characters at most.
Do not carry meaning by the tone alone; the word says it too.
Do not make a badge a button.

states.danger: Failed or blocked, the danger tone.
states.neutral: A count in the control fill.
states.success: Done or online, the success tone.
states.warning: Needs a look, the warning tone.

components.summary: A small pill with a count or one word about the thing beside it.

a11y.description: None; a longer reason goes in the surface text.
a11y.name: Its label.

anatomy.fill: control for default, accent for primary, danger for destructive, none for plain
anatomy.label: 13 px medium, Title Case verb phrase

copy.label: A verb phrase in Title Case: Install, Add Printer; never Click Here or OK when a verb fits.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the button.

components.name: Button

rules.text: A surface has one primary button; the other actions are default or plain.
Do not use a destructive button for an action that loses nothing.
A button whose action runs waits and shows a spinner beside it; it never stays pressable.
A button is named by its own label, and a button without words is an icon button.

regular.use: every button; the width follows the label

states.busy: The action runs: the button waits and a 16 px spinner turns beside it.
states.default: The quiet button: the safe choice or one of several.
states.destructive: Deletes or erases; the label names what is lost.
states.disabled: The action is not possible now; nothing explains it on the button, the surface does.
states.plain: A text action with no fill, for quiet or inline choices.
states.primary: The one action the surface is for; one per surface.

components.summary: Starts one action; its label says what it does.

a11y.name: The row title and the colour in words or hex.

anatomy.palette: a popover with swatches and a #rrggbb field
anatomy.well: a 22 px disc in the colour, ringed in the line colour; a clear colour sits on a two-tone disc

keyboard.Enter: In the hex field, applies a valid colour.
keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the well.

components.name: Colour well

rules.text: A colour is also shown as text (the tooltip), never by the disc alone.
The palette reports a valid colour only; a mistyped hex changes nothing.

components.summary: Shows one colour and opens a small palette to change it.

a11y.description: The row subtitle (described-by), when there is one.
a11y.name: The row title (labelled-by).

anatomy.button: control fill, 1 px line, radius 8, the picked option and a chevron
anatomy.search: a search field on top of the list when there are many options

copy.option: One to three words in Title Case; the list is ordered by how often people pick.

keyboard.Escape: Closes the list without a change.
keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the dropdown.

components.name: Dropdown

rules.text: A dropdown reports its pick once and applies it at once.
A list of more than about twelve options has a search field.
A change that leaves the process uses the pending dropdown, which waits and puts the confirmed choice back on failure (RC-01).
Do not use a dropdown for two or three options that fit on screen; use a segmented control.

states.search: A long list: the pop-up has a search field.

components.summary: Picks one option from a short list in a pop-up menu.

copy.hint: Says how to add it in one line.
copy.title: Says what is missing: Nothing here yet.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the action, when there is one.

components.name: Empty state

rules.text: An empty page says what to do next, in one line and at most one action.
Do not leave a page blank when there is nothing to show.

states.action: Icon, title, hint and one button.

components.summary: Fills a page that has nothing yet with one picture, one line and at most one action.

anatomy.line: 11 or 13 px, the danger colour, wraps, hidden when empty

copy.sentence: Says what to do, not what failed: That name is taken. Try another.

keyboard.None: An error line is not interactive and not in the Tab order.

components.name: Error line

rules.text: An error line says what to do in one sentence and is drawn in the danger colour.
Do not show an error line before the person has done something.

states.hidden: No problem: nothing is drawn and no space is kept.

components.summary: Says what is wrong with one field, in one sentence, under it.

anatomy.caption: 11 px secondary under the ring, one line
anatomy.ring: track at 18 %, fill in the tone, round caps, from the top clockwise

keyboard.None: A gauge is not interactive and not in the Tab order.

components.name: Gauge

rules.text: A gauge shows its value in words as well as in the ring.
A gauge exposes its caption and value to assistive technology.

states.danger: 56 px near the limit, the danger tone.

components.summary: Shows a share of a whole as a ring with its value in the middle.

anatomy.glyph: 16 px symbolic icon in the text colour

copy.tooltip: Names the action in Title Case, two words at most: Add, Show Sidebar.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the button.

components.name: Icon button

rules.text: An icon button has a tooltip, and the tooltip is its accessible name.
Do not use an icon button for an action the glyph cannot say; use a button with words.
A toolbar holds at most five actions; the rest go in a menu button.

states.disabled: The action is not possible now.

components.summary: Starts one action with a 16 px glyph; its tooltip is its name.

anatomy.menu: a popover of action rows, destructive last

copy.tooltip: More, or the name of the thing the actions are for.

components.hig: hig.md section 1 (Toolbar: the rest in a menu)

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the button.

components.name: Menu button

rules.text: A menu button with no actions is not built.
A menu button has a tooltip and opens with Space and Enter.
Do not hide the one action people need most behind a menu button.

components.summary: Opens a short menu of actions for one row or one surface.

a11y.name: The text beside it says what is measured (labelled-by).

copy.neighbour: The value in words next to it: 6.2 GB of 8 GB.

rules.text: A meter is clamped to the whole: a share above 100 % draws full.
Do not carry meaning by the tone alone; the value is in words beside it.

regular.why: A track is an optical length, not spacing: 6 px reads between the 4 px progress bar and the 8 px installer bar.

states.danger: A share near the limit, the danger tone.

components.summary: Shows a share of a whole (memory, a quota) as a bar in a tone.

anatomy.actions: buttons on the right, centred on the text
anatomy.icon: 16 px warning glyph in the warning colour

copy.sentence: Says what is wrong and what can be done, with the names in quotes: Super+Space is used by Show Search.

components.name: Notice

rules.text: A notice sits next to what it is about, not at the top of the window.
A notice is one sentence and its buttons are verbs.
Do not use a notice for something that only needs a toast.

states.actions: A warning and one or two buttons.
states.text: A warning with no way out on the notice itself.

components.summary: Warns next to its cause, in one sentence, with the ways out as buttons.

a11y.name: The placeholder or the label next to it.

components.name: Password field

rules.text: A password field never shows what was typed unless the person asks (peek).
The Caps Lock note says so in words under the field, not only with an icon.
Do not put a secret in a text field, a log, a tooltip or a golden.

states.disabled: The field cannot take input now.

components.name: Progress bar

rules.text: A progress bar that knows its fraction shows it; one that does not is indeterminate.
Do not move a bar backwards.
A progress bar has a name and exposes its value to assistive technology.

states.indeterminate: Running, with no known end: the fill moves.

components.summary: Shows how much of a job is done, or that it runs when that is not known.

components.summary: Shows a job's progress in 24 px, beside a name in a tile or a row.

keyboard.Escape: Clears the text, then leaves the field.
keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus into the field.

components.name: Search field

rules.text: A search field is the rightmost item of the toolbar.
A search field shows results as the person types and keeps the typed text when they leave.
A search field has a name for assistive technology.

states.empty: Nothing typed; the placeholder names what is searched.
states.filled: Text typed; the clear button shows.

components.summary: Filters or finds as the person types; a clear button appears with text.

a11y.description: The row subtitle (described-by), when there is one.
a11y.name: The row title (labelled-by).

anatomy.segment: one toggle button per option; the picked one has the card fill and elevation 1

copy.segment: One or two words in Title Case, the same grammatical kind in every segment.

components.hig: hig.md section 1 (Settings-style apps: Light / Dark / Auto)

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus into the control and out of it.

components.name: Segmented control

rules.text: A segmented control holds two to four options and applies the pick at once.
Do not use a segmented control for more than four options or for options that start actions; use a dropdown or buttons.
A segmented control in a row is named by the row title for assistive technology.

states.disabled: No option can be picked now.

components.summary: Shows two to four exclusive choices at once and applies the picked one.

a11y.description: The row title says which command.
a11y.name: The shown combination.

anatomy.button: a button 112 px wide that shows the combination, or Off, or Type Shortcut while it listens
anatomy.warning: an outline when another shortcut already has the combination

copy.off: Off, never None or Not Set.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the recorder.

components.name: Shortcut recorder

rules.text: A recorder pauses the other shortcuts while it listens and resumes them when it stops.
A recorder that loses the keyboard stops without a change.
A combination that another command has is marked with the warning outline and offers to swap.

states.conflict: The shown combination is taken by another shortcut: a warning outline.
states.locked: A fixed shortcut: it shows its keys and cannot be recorded.
states.off: No combination; the button says Off.
states.recording: Listening: the button says Type Shortcut; Escape stops, Backspace clears.

components.summary: Records the key combination a person types for one command.

anatomy.ends: optional low and high words (11 px, dim) either side
anatomy.highlight: accent from the start to the knob

copy.ends: Two single words that say the direction: Slow and Fast, never 0 and 100.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the knob.

components.name: Slider

rules.text: A slider reports its value once, after the knob settles, not on every pixel.
A slider row names its ends in words and its title names the setting.
Do not use a slider for a choice among a few named options; use a segmented control.

states.high: The knob is at the high end.
states.low: The knob is at the low end of the range.

components.summary: Sets a number on a range by dragging; the change applies when the knob settles.

a11y.name: The text beside it says what runs.

anatomy.wheel: the toolkit spinner in the text colour

copy.beside: A line next to a large spinner says what runs: Loading apps.

keyboard.None: A spinner is not interactive and not in the Tab order.

components.name: Spinner

rules.text: A spinner shows only while work runs and is hidden and still otherwise.
Do not show a spinner for work whose progress is known; use a progress bar.
Work longer than a second shows a spinner, and longer than ten seconds says what runs.

states.large: 32 px, centred on a page that loads.
states.regular: 16 px, beside a control that waits.

components.summary: Shows that work is running when its length is not known.

anatomy.value: the formatted number, right aligned, 6 characters wide

copy.value: The number with its unit (12 pt); a unit is never dropped.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to Less, then More.

components.name: Stepper

rules.text: A button that would leave the range waits instead of doing nothing.
Do not use a stepper for a range of more than about 30 steps; use a slider.
A stepper exposes its value, minimum and maximum to assistive technology.

states.rest: A value inside the range; both buttons work.

components.summary: Changes a number one step at a time with Less and More buttons.

a11y.description: The row subtitle (described-by), when there is one.
a11y.name: The row title (labelled-by).

anatomy.thumb: white, elevation 1, a circle inset by the padding
anatomy.track: control-off when off, accent when on; a pill

copy.title: The row title names the setting, not the action: Bluetooth, never Turn On Bluetooth.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the switch.

components.name: Switch

rules.text: A switch applies its change at once; no Save or Apply button follows it.
Do not use a switch to start an action such as Install or Restart; use a button.
A change that leaves the process uses the pending switch: it waits, then shows the confirmed state (RC-01).
A switch in a row is named by the row title and described by its subtitle for assistive technology.

small.use: compact density, and the Control Center detail header

states.disabled: The setting cannot change now; the row subtitle says why.
states.pending: The change runs: the switch waits, a 16 px spinner turns beside it, a failure flips it back.

components.summary: Turns one setting on or off, and the change applies at once.

anatomy.field: control fill, 1 px line, radius 8, padding 0 8
anatomy.placeholder: dim text that says what to type

copy.placeholder: An example or the kind of text, never the label again.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus into the field.

components.name: Text field

rules.text: A text field commits once on Enter or when it loses the keyboard with a changed text, never on every key.
A commit that can fail or be cancelled uses the pending field, which waits and lets Enter commit the same text again (QA-SET-12).
A text field in a row is named by the row title for assistive technology.
Do not use a placeholder as the only label of a field.

states.filled: Text typed or loaded; nothing to save until it changes.
states.pending: The commit runs: the field waits, a failure or a cancel puts it back and Enter commits the same text again.

components.summary: Takes one line of text; the change applies on Enter or when the field loses the keyboard.

a11y.name: Its title; the action button has its own label.

anatomy.action: Get or Open, or the progress ring while it installs
anatomy.source: a badge when it is not WolOS's own package
anatomy.title: 13 px semibold, one line

copy.summary: What the app does in a few words, no marketing.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the action button.

components.name: Tile

rules.text: A tile shows one action at a time: the button or the progress, never both.
An app that does not come from WolOS's packages says where from.

states.progress: Installing: the ring shows the progress in place of the button.

components.summary: A store tile: an app's icon, name and summary with one action (Get or Open) or its progress.

anatomy.action: one plain button in the accent ink, optional
anatomy.pill: glass fill, 1 px line, radius 999, elevation 2, 16 px from the bottom edge of the content

copy.line: What happened, past tense, no full stop: Theme changed. The action is one verb: Undo.

keyboard.Tab: Moves the focus to the action, when there is one.

components.name: Toast

rules.text: A toast replaces the previous toast and leaves after six seconds, longer when Give me more time is set.
Do not put a decision or an error that needs reading in a toast; use a notice or a sheet.
A toast has at most one action, and using it hides the toast.

states.action: A line and one action (Undo); using it runs the action and hides the toast.

components.summary: Says one short thing that just happened, with at most one action to undo it, and leaves on its own.

a11y.name: None; it names the control, it is not named.

copy.text: A name, three words at most, Title Case, no full stop: Show Sidebar.

components.hig: hig.md section 1 (Toolbar: icon-only buttons need a tooltip)

keyboard.Tab: A focused control shows its tooltip like a hover (the toolkit does this).

components.name: Tooltip

rules.text: A tooltip is a name of at most three words in Title Case with no full stop.
Do not hide information in a tooltip that a person needs to act; tooltips name, they do not explain.

states.owner: The control that owns the tooltip; the bubble itself cannot be mounted headless, so the case holds the contract on its owner.

components.summary: Names a control that has no words, after the pointer rests on it.
